meaning:
1) to be low, be humiliated
1a) (Qal) to be low, be humiliated
1b) (Niphal) to sink
1c) (Hophal) to be brought low

renderings.kjv: but are gone and brought low

elsewhere.note: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of…
He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks.
